subject: PrivDeploy commercial terms: platform fee amortization & staged SRE retainer
messages:
From: Sara Cohen <sara.cohen@helixhealth.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: Jim Keller <jim.keller@helixhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: PrivDeploy commercial clarifications: platform fee amortization & SRE retainer

Jonas —

Thanks for the call this morning. A couple of items procurement needs clarified before we take this back to the finance committee:

1) Platform fee amortization: Helix prefers capitalized treatment where possible. Can Redwood amortize the one-time platform fee over 24 months on the invoice so our finance team can treat the cost more like a capital project? If not, what are the invoicing alternatives (monthly spread, upfront with credit, etc.)?

2) SRE / on-call retainer: We're proposing a ramped SRE retainer (start: 8 hours/week ramp to 20 hours/week over 3 months) tied to go-live. Requesting a starter credit (one month of retainer waived) if we commit to a 24-month term.

3) Migration retainer vs. migration credits: we want a 3-month migration retainer but would like credits applied to the first invoice if certain milestones are met (milestones attached).

We captured these in a short procurement checklist (attached). Please confirm feasibility and any pricing impact.

Regards,

Sara Cohen
Head of Procurement, HelixHealth
procurement@helixhealth.com

Attachment: procurement_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet - checklist + milestone matrix)

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sara Cohen <sara.cohen@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PrivDeploy commercial clarifications: platform fee amortization & SRE retainer

Sara —

Appreciate the clear list. Short answers below + attached a draft support proposal for your team to review.

1) Platform fee amortization: We can offer an invoicing option that spreads the platform fee evenly over 24 months for accounting purposes (monthly line item) while permitting Redwood to recognize revenue per our standard terms. That will be a billing presentation change only — no change to total economics if you keep the standard 24-month commitment. If you prefer upfront payment in exchange for a discount, we can provide that as an alternate commercial.

2) SRE retainer ramp: We can accommodate the ramp: 8 hrs/wk (months 0–1), 12 hrs/wk (month 2), 20 hrs/wk (month 3 onward). Starter credit: we can offer one month waived if Helix signs a 24-month commitment and a minimum capacity commit (details below).

3) Migration retainer vs credits: We recommend a 3-month migration retainer with a milestone-based credit schedule (50% credit on successful data migration, 25% on latency/throughput stabilization, 25% on operational handoff). We've sketched the milestones in the attached.

Commercial levers we propose for a fast close: a) 15% discount on the platform fee if you elect upfront payment; b) 10% discount on first-year platform fee if you sign 24 months and accept the amortized monthly invoice presentation; c) starter credit (one month SRE retainer) delivered as invoice credit after go-live.

I've attached the helix_support_proposal_v1.pdf that lays this out with numbers and an example amortization schedule. If everything looks good, Marissa (cc'd) can review the commercial and we can circulate an Order Form for signatures.

Best,

Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

Attachment: helix_support_proposal_v1.pdf (proposal PDF - amortization table + SRE schedule)

From: Sara Cohen <sara.cohen@helixhealth.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: Jim Keller <jim.keller@helixhealth.com>, procurement@helixhealth.com
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PrivDeploy commercial clarifications: platform fee amortization & SRE retainer

Jonas / Marissa —

Thanks for the proposal. A few follow-ups from finance and engineering:

- Amortization presentation: Finance confirmed the monthly line-item is acceptable as long as we receive a formal invoice schedule with the same total platform fee. They asked whether Redwood can include a short invoice note referencing the 24-month amortization.

- Discount ask: Helix is willing to sign 24 months but needs a stronger commercial incentive. Can Redwood move to a 20% first-year platform fee discount if we sign within 10 business days?

- SRE ramp & credit: Procurement supports the starter credit. Engineering asked whether the retainer can guarantee a response SLA for P1 incidents during the ramp (we'd like 30-minute acknowledgement).

- SOC2 evidence: we need a copy of Redwood's latest SOC 2 Type II report for our audit. Please indicate whether this is available under NDA or via a secure artifact link.

I've attached the procurement_requirements.xlsx with the annotated fields from finance.

Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can move to legal and signature.

Sara

Attachment: procurement_requirements.xlsx (annotated)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sara Cohen <sara.cohen@helixhealth.com>, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 10:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PrivDeploy commercial clarifications: platform fee amortization & SRE retainer

Sara —

Thanks — looping in Kimberly (rev ops) for invoice language. Quick commercial compromise for Helix that I can get approved by RevOps and Sales Leadership:

- First-year platform fee: 15% discount if Helix signs within 10 business days and accepts amortized monthly presentation. That's our standard accelerated-close concession.
- Alternatively, 20% discount is available only for full upfront payment (no amortization).
- Starter SRE credit: one month waived delivered as an invoice credit after go-live AND a guaranteed 30-minute P1 acknowledgement during the ramp window. We will document the acknowledgement SLA in the SOW and route P1s to a named on-call desk.
- Migration: 3-month migration retainer with milestone-based credits as Jonas outlined.

If Helix can confirm which invoicing preference they prefer (monthly amortized vs upfront) and the sign-by date, I will get the Order Form updated and legal will prepare the SOC 2 access NDA.

I'll also add invoice language: "Platform fee invoiced as a 24-month amortization schedule for accounting presentation; total fee unchanged unless upfront payment discount elected."

Best,

Marissa Cole
Sr. Commercial Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Cc: Kimberly Park (rev ops)

Note: Attachment for internal use: redwood_privdeploy_order_form.pdf (draft)

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sara Cohen <sara.cohen@helixhealth.com>, Jim Keller <jim.keller@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PrivDeploy commercial clarifications: platform fee amortization & SRE retainer — confirmation and next steps

Sara / Jim —

Thanks for the quick back-and-forth. Per Marissa's note, here is the agreed path that I will put into the Order Form:

- Term: 24 months (HLX-2025-022).
- Platform fee: 15% discount applied to first-year platform fee if Helix signs within 10 business days and elects monthly amortized invoicing (monthly amortization line item will appear on invoices).
- Upfront option: 20% discount if Helix elects single upfront payment (no amortization).
- SRE retainer: ramp as proposed (8 -> 12 -> 20 hrs/week). One-month starter credit delivered as invoice credit post go-live. 30-minute P1 acknowledgement guaranteed and documented in SOW.
- Migration: 3-month retainer with milestone-based credits (50/25/25).
- SOC2: We'll provide access to the SOC 2 Type II report via a secure NDA portal (link will be sent by Kimberly).

Next steps: Marissa will attach the updated Order Form and Kimberly will share the NDA + SOC2 access link. Once Helix confirms invoicing preference (monthly amortization vs upfront), we'll route for signatures (DocuSign link below).
